observations.name: triage INC-0001
observations.output: {"root_cause_category": "config_or_deploy_change", "explanation": "The checkout-api 2026.11.3 deploy at 14:01:30 raised WORKER_CONCURRENCY from 8 to 32 (LOG-0001-0006). The service then started 32 workers (LOG-0001-0007) but the orders-db pool stayed at max_connections 20 (LOG-0001-0008). Before the deploy the pool had 6 of 20 connections in use and nothing waiting (LOG-0001-0003). After it, usage climbed to 17 with 3 waiting (LOG-0001-0013), then the pool filled completely and the queue grew to 70 (LOG-0001-0016, LOG-0001-0038). checkout-api then timed out after 3000 ms waiting for a connection (LOG-0001-0023) and returned 503s (LOG-0001-0024), which pushed p99 latency to 3020 ms (LOG-0001-0036). That matches TKT-0001: customers see checkout spin, then fail. The cache miss spike after the deploy is a red herring: the miss rate was back to normal by 14:04:58 (LOG-0001-0014), but the pool kept getting worse. The pool did not run out on its own; the config change caused it. Rolling back WORKER_CONCURRENCY, or sizing the pool to match it, should end the incident.", "evidence_ids": ["LOG-0001-0003", "LOG-0001-0006", "LOG-0001-0007", "LOG-0001-0008", "LOG-0001-0013", "LOG-0001-0014", "LOG-0001-0016", "LOG-0001-0023", "LOG-0001-0024", "LOG-0001-0036", "LOG-0001-0038", "TKT-0001"]}
